useCases.tool: rotary drilling rig with Kelly bar, drilling bucket or auger, casing and concreting pipe
useCases.sensing: drilling depth, verticality, tool fill level and concrete level
useCases.reason: An 84 t rotary drilling rig drills and concretes the pile; its drilling tools alone weigh 0.4 to 1.8 t and the finished pile carries the structure.

useCases.tool: excavator with four-leg chain sling, spindle wrench, bolts and pins
useCases.sensing: trench width, A-position of the box (lower struts 4 to 5 cm wider), contact with the soil
useCases.reason: Trench boxes of 1.4 to 3.4 t are lifted, pushed in and pulled by the excavator; failing shoring buries people, so the crew assembles it on the surface.
